topology: F1 -> Q1 drain; source -> protected bus; gate ->10k->GND; zener cathode at source/anode at gate
limitations: 74A is a case-temperature rating, not free-air assembly capacity
V1 is bench-current-limited to a few amps; 12A is copper-sizing worst case, not continuous operation
Single P-MOS stage does not block reverse load current or guarantee hot reverse connection with a charged output
Zener is a nominal 12V clamp; no transient/surge qualification

prototype_decisions.scope: Accepted v1 prototype decisions; documentation/export only, no board or firmware changes

q1.readme_note: Q1 needs no heat sink below ~5 A continuous.
q1.continuous_operating_current: A few amps, bench PSU current-limited

kill_supply_ramp.rationale: No PWM drive while 3.3V ramps; firmware boots motor disabled and initFOC runs only on command. EN alone is not a motion command.
kill_supply_ramp.electrical_guarantee: Original buffer DC guarantees are unchanged; acceptance is a system/operating-scope decision.

encoder_3v3_budget.conclusion: Within the external3.3V allowance with buffers and bias circuitry; accepted for v1

spi_return_paths.mitigation: Reduce SPI clock further if encoder reads glitch

assembly.reason: Same connector/package lead-free/tin variant; original listing out of stock, C160405 stocked at verification
